question: The efficiency of a chromatographic separation can be increased:

options.opa: Increasing the particle diameter of the stationary phase.
options.opb: Decreasing the thickness of the layer of the liquid stationary phase.
options.opc: Increasing the viscosity of the stationary phase.
options.opd: Increasing the diameter of the column.

analysis: The efficiency of a chromatographic separation is often related to the resolution and speed of the separation process. Decreasing the thickness of the liquid stationary phase layer can enhance mass transfer and reduce band broadening, leading to improved separation efficiency. This is because a thinner stationary phase allows for faster equilibration between the stationary and mobile phases, improving peak sharpness and resolution.
